text: McDonald's Corporation's common stock (trading symbol MCD) is registered on the New York Stock Exchange. Its 2026 proxy statement lists all beneficial owners of more than 5% of its common stock at 31 December 2025: The Vanguard Group (10.03%), BlackRock (7.3%) and State Street (5.1%).
short: McDonald's is a New York Stock Exchange-listed company
